model.title: BEACON Act of 2026
model.meta: Veterans' Affairs Committee · Rep. Jack Bergman (R-MI)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Department of Veterans Affairs to award grants to organizations conducting research on treatments for traumatic brain injury, with a focus on rigorous clinical trials testing neurorehabilitation approaches.
